verdict.rationale: AngelList documents a first-party HRIS/payroll integration: you select a provider under People > Configuration > Integrations, and it automatically terminates employees in AngelList when they are terminated in the HRIS/payroll system. The evidence does not show new hires flowing into stakeholder or equity records, and it never names the supported providers such as Gusto or Rippling. missing for 10: documented automatic new-hire/stakeholder creation from HRIS, named supported providers (Gusto, Rippling), detail on how synced changes update equity records, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically

citations.quote: Navigate to People > Configuration > Integrations and select your provider.
Automatically terminate employees in AngelList when employees are terminated in your HRIS/payroll systems.
AngelList Equity enables you to record terminations and update related securities on your cap table.
